fuelPrices.subtitle: Live pump prices from filling stations around you. Pick your grade, set a radius and see who is cheapest right now.

setup.title: One-time setup needed
setup.body: Live fuel prices come from Tankerkönig, which publishes the prices every German filling station has to report to the Federal Cartel Office. The service is free but needs your own personal API key.
setup.step1: Request a free API key at creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de (takes a minute).
setup.step2: In Unraid: Docker → smart-garage → Edit → set the variable TANKERKOENIG_API_KEY to your key.
setup.step3: Apply and restart the container — this page then works right away.
